newsitem.title: CHINA: Styland plans convertible note issue.
newsitem.headline: Styland plans convertible note issue.

text.p: Styland Holdings Ltd said it planned to issue a HK$115.4 million convertible note, carrying the right of conversion into shares at HK$0.37 per share.

The company said in a statement on Friday that the note would bear interest at HIBOR, payable half yearly. On full conversion, 312 million shares would be issued, representing about 15.4 percent of its existing issued share capital.

Styland intends to use the proceeds to expand its property investment and agency business and its finance and securities business, and also to finance the re-development of its property at Fei Ngo Shan in Hong Kong.
The stock closed at HK$0.56 on Thursday.
